step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an ingestion, processing, search, and recommendation pipeline for vendor catalog data. Unstructured catalogs in S3 are processed by SageMaker and Step Functions into DynamoDB. DynamoDB streams sync data to Elasticsearch and Neptune graph database via Lambda. Users interact through API Gateway, Lambda, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, and Neptune.
